1.Tips: A hero's maximum level is determined by their ascension level.

2.Tips: A maximum of 12 hours of AFK Rewards can be stored.

3.Tips: All resources used on a hero will be returned to you if you choose to reset them.

4.Tips: There are no level requirements for equipment.

5.Tips: Certain equipment can give your heroes factional attribute bonuses.

6.Tips: Take advantage of factional advantages to make your battles easier.

7.Tips: Form unions at the Library to strengthen your heroes.

8.Tips: Different heroes have different maximum ascension levels.

9.Tips: There are many riches to be found through guild hunting.

10.Tips: Change your formation to complete stages more efficiently.

11.Tips: You can read your heroes' background stories from within the portraits section.

12.Tips: Adjust your battle formation to get the most out of your heroes.

13.Tips: Choosing a suitable position can allow your heroes to fight to their maximum potential.

14.Tips: Choose frontline heroes that possess factional advantages over your opponent's heroes.

15.Tips: If your heroes are defeated you can try rearranging your battle formation.

16.Tips: If you have a surplus of common heroes, you can retire them at the Rickety Cart in exchange for resources.

17.Tips: Damage over time ignores defense, but don't worry, it can't kill you.

18.Tips: Heroes can recover energy when they suffer damage.

19.Tips: Heroes can't recover energy from damage over time.

20.Tips: High damage attacks may interrupt a hero's actions.

21.Tips: Most summoned beings die when the person that summoned them dies.

22.Tips: Haste can increase the frequency a hero attacks at, as well as the speed of their actions.
